value.answer: Tuesday in Windsor looks hot and a bit stormy early on. High of 29, humidex around 35. Mainly cloudy with a 30% chance of showers and a risk of thunder early in the morning, clearing by late morning. It gets windy later in the morning, southwest at 40 km/h gusting to 60. Tuesday night drops to a low of 15 with a 40% chance of showers before morning.
